title: Create authenticated Foundation policy-waiver authority
description:
AUTHORITY-GRANTING FOLLOW-UP split from task-064b97584aff4e07967738f79134a723 after task-e74d3116cbeb4abb96becb08b5896c8e explicitly ruled that Foundation currently has no waiver and no humanApprovalRef mapping.

OBJECTIVE: only after an explicit human product decision, add the authenticated human-approval record, durable writer, strict reader, and validation required to produce a scoped, expiring, SOFT-only PolicyWaiver.

DELIVERABLE: a production human action writes an immutable approval record; the waiver reader joins it to project/principal/action/obligation/scope, rejects expiry or foreign identity, and policy.validate consumes only verified waivers.

NOT IN SCOPE: policy-risk tier classification, autoApprovalOptIns, fabricating humanApprovalRef, waiving HARD obligations or required facts, lifting HOLD_UNKNOWN, or relaxing admission/budget gates.

SAFETY ORDERING: this row is not a prerequisite to delivering the fail-closed resolved-empty waiver behavior in task-064. It is required before any future live non-empty Foundation waiver can be accepted. Keep it BLOCKED until the human authorizes the record and authenticated action.

VERIFICATION COMMAND: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`; the fresh foreground output must contain nonzero Test Files and Tests lines and exit 0.
definitionOfDone: Before source edits, a durable Moe comment records the human-approved approval-record contract, authenticated human action and writer, strict reader, humanApprovalRef derivation, project/principal/action/obligation/scope join keys, expiry semantics, and revocation/supersession rule; absent that decision, the task reports BLOCKED.

Production code creates waiver authority only from an authenticated human action and a durable immutable record; caller-carried waiver fields or approval references are refused before any authority read with exact stable reason code and refusing layer.

The strict reader accepts only unexpired, same-project, same-principal/action, exact-obligation, nonempty-scope, SOFT-only approvals and distinguishes missing, unreadable, stale, revoked, and foreign records without granting authority.
policy.validate consumes the verified waiver reader; resolved-empty remains the result when no approval exists, and no waiver can suppress a HARD obligation, required fact, or HOLD_UNKNOWN.

Focused TDD covers the valid record and every hostile constructibility case, asserts exact code and layer, proves a nonzero generated roster, and includes production mutation drills for expiry, scope, SOFT-only, and humanApprovalRef binding.
`pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` runs standalone in the foreground, exits 0, and prints nonzero Test Files and Tests counts; `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` also exits 0.
taskRails: This row grants new human-approval authority. No architect or worker may choose the record, authenticated command, join keys, scope, expiry, or revocation semantics without an explicit human decision on a durable Moe surface.
No fabricated humanApprovalRef, demo/fixture approval, caller-carried waiver, or unrelated approval/recovery record may be repurposed.
Waivers are scoped, expiring, human-approved, and SOFT-only; they never lift HOLD_UNKNOWN or waive required facts/HARD obligations.
TDD, exact refusal code and layer, per-production-file size caps, and explicit-pathspec commits apply.

comments.author: architect-73c0eab1
comments.content:
HUMAN-GATED, SAME CLASS AND SAME RULING AS task-b211ac9de4944582ae19aa73afda7b25. architect-73c0eab1 at HEAD ae83f365, 2026-08-26.

The human was asked directly this session about the policy-RISK sibling and ruled: park it, keep the board on deliverables. I am applying that ruling to this row without re-asking, because the two rows are the same shape — both are AUTHORITY-GRANTING follow-ups split from task-064b9758, both have a DoD item 1 that says design nothing until a human names the contract, and both have a taskRail 1 forbidding an architect or worker from choosing it. If the human intends a different answer for waivers specifically, this comment is the place to say so and nothing here presumes otherwise.

THE FAIL-CLOSED HALF IS ALREADY DELIVERED AND COMMITTED, so parking regresses nothing. `apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/policy-fact-resolver.ts:26` exports `resolvePolicyWaivers()`, which returns a frozen RESOLVED_EMPTY — status "RESOLVED_EMPTY" with a frozen empty waiver list. Its docstring records the reasoning and the measurement: "Policy waivers require a real humanApprovalRef (policy-contract.ts:102-108), and Foundation has no such record." It is deliberately zero-argument so it HAS no branch that could mint a waiver, and it makes consultation distinguishable from absence — which is exactly DoD item 4's "resolved-empty remains the result when no approval exists".

There is also a STRUCTURAL guarantee behind DoD item 4's second half, already in production and independent of this row: HOLD_UNKNOWN dominates ALLOW and a waiver can only suppress a layer-2 relaxation, so a waiver structurally cannot turn HOLD_UNKNOWN into ALLOW (policy-evaluation.ts:12-14). No waiver this row might later add can lift HOLD_UNKNOWN even if someone tried.

SO THE ONLY THING LEFT IN THIS ROW IS THE PRODUCT DECISION. There is no residual coding slice: every path to a real PolicyWaiver requires first choosing the authenticated human action and the immutable approval record that produces a humanApprovalRef, and task-e74d3116 already ruled that Foundation has no waiver and no humanApprovalRef mapping today. Designing one here would be fabricating authority — the one condition the DELIVERY BIAS global rail still permits a row to stop on, and precisely what taskRail 2 forbids ("no fabricated humanApprovalRef").

THE 2026-08-25 UNIVERSAL BOARD UNBLOCK IS NOT THAT DECISION. Its own text states it "grants no credential, signer, release approval, committed byte, or success verdict". It moved the status; it authorized nothing.

BLOCKS NOTHING. Per this row's own SAFETY ORDERING it is not a prerequisite to the fail-closed task-064 slice, and policy.validate keeps answering resolved-empty, which is the safe answer.

THE EXACT DECISION OWED, so the next human read is short. Name, on a durable Moe surface: (1) the authenticated human ACTION that constitutes approval; (2) the immutable durable approval record it writes; (3) the humanApprovalRef derivation; (4) the strict reader's join keys — project, principal, action, obligation, scope; (5) expiry semantics; (6) revocation semantics. Still forbidden as substitutes, per taskRail 2: a fabricated humanApprovalRef, any demo or fixture approval, caller-carried waiver fields, and any unrelated approval or recovery record repurposed as waiver authority. Waivers remain scoped, expiring, SOFT-only, and may never waive a HARD obligation or a required fact.

No plan submitted. No source or test bytes changed. Row left PLANNING and claimable so no status hop is needed once the decision lands.
